dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you! What do you do?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs tə ˈmiːt juː! ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm a doctor. My husband is a nurse.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ə ˈdɑːktər. maɪ ˈhʌzbənd ɪz ə ˈnɜːrs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! My parents are teachers.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈnaɪs! maɪ ˈpɛrənts ər ˈtiːtʃərz.
